brief.situation: 15:00 in an outpatient oncology rehabilitation clinic. You are the physical therapist. Ms. Rhodes, 47, is 9 days after her third chemotherapy cycle. She says she feels 'shivery and wiped out' but 'doesn't want to miss a session'.
handover: Her blood count from 2 days ago showed an ANC of 700 'and falling', per her oncology portal.
Clinic policy: any temperature of 38.0 or more, or chills, in a patient on chemotherapy: hold exercise and call the oncology triage line at once; they direct her to the emergency department.
howItWorks: The clock runs in simulated time; study pace runs three simulated minutes per real minute. Pause any time.
Each check takes the time on its button. Decide what the findings mean, what to stop or start, and who must know.
Partway through you are asked to write your reasoning. A debrief scores what you did.

why.question: What does Ms. Rhodes's fever mean, and what do you do?

parts.label: What and why
parts.criteria: A temperature of 38.6 at her chemotherapy nadir with an ANC of 700 and falling (expected under 500) is febrile neutropenia, an emergency; the red port is a likely source.
parts.modelAnswer: She's 38.6 at her nadir with an ANC of 700 and falling. That's febrile neutropenia, an emergency, and the port looks infected.

sepsis.headline: Neutropenic sepsis
sepsis.body: A fever in a patient on chemotherapy, especially at nadir, is febrile neutropenia until proven otherwise: hold exercise and call oncology triage at once.

safe.headline: Febrile neutropenia caught
safe.body: You took her temperature before exercise, held the session, linked it to her nadir and called within minutes. That is the expert path.

safeGaps.headline: Sent, with gaps
safeGaps.body: Check whether you exercised her and how soon you called.

scoring.modelReasoning: Febrile neutropenia is a temperature of 38.3 C once or 38 C for an hour with an ANC below 500 or expected to fall below 500 within 48 hours; it is an emergency, and an ANC below 100 is profound. Take a temperature before exercise in anyone on chemotherapy. Ms. Rhodes is 38.6 at her nadir with a falling ANC and a red port: hold exercise and call oncology triage at once.
